text:
ryan: FYI we had a tenant POST a single embeddings request with ~1200 items (mixed dims 512/768/1024) gzipped. ingress backlog spiked ~50s.
ana: ouch. splitter gave a few 413s but most of the time the request stayed open and continuous-batching held resources. p99 spiked.
ana: header they sent: `X-Embed-Dims: 512,768,1024,512,...` and no per-item size hints. gzip helped but framed payload > max_bytes.
ana: link to redacted trace: https://s3.redwood/trace/1843217654 (private)
console-pm: Customers just saw a vague 413. We should return actionable hints (suggested chunk size + help link) so SDKs can auto-split.
infra: runtime options: (A) cheap LB preflight that estimates "embed-units" from dims + compressed_bytes and returns structured reject + header; (B) route heavy requests to a slowpath worker pool; (C) fast-reject with suggested chunk header.
sdk-lead: preference is preflight + header so SDK can transparently split before sending. Fast-reject works too but leads to retry churn. We can add `X-Embed-Client-Chunked: true` on retries so we measure conversion.
telemetry: we need low-cardinality fields: `embeds.preflight_units_bucket`, `ingress.heavy_flag`, `reject.with_hint`, `sdk.autochunk_pct`. Also capture `orig_compressed_bytes_bucket` and `orig_max_dim_bucket`.
console-pm: UX: inline preflight estimator on the Embeddings console route (paste or file upload) showing estimated units and recommended chunk count + a CTA: "Enable SDK auto-chunk". Also show a one-line banner on API keys that had >5 oversize rejects.
infra: rollout plan: 1) metrics-only preflight (emit telemetry) for 2w; 2) SDK opt-in with preflight hints; 3) soft-reject (429 + `X-Embed-Suggest-Chunks`) for 5% tenants; 4) global fast-reject default.
nana: implement ingress quick-check: math = sum(dim_weight(dim) * item_count) scaled by compressed_bytes / BASE_FRAME. simple and safe. Add unit tests with gzip/no-gzip framing.
sdk-lead: we'll ship an SDK autop-chunk helper and opt-in flag. will handle `X-Embed-Suggest-Chunks` header and preflight return. We'll set `X-Embed-Client-Chunked: true` on retries.
console-pm: docs blurb + example code snippet for autop-chunk added. I'll include a small modal: "Estimated units: 420 (high). Recommended chunk size: 100. Try SDK auto-chunk or streaming embeddings."
telemetry: will add dashboard: preflight -> reject -> retry_success funnel, plus per-tenant bulk-shed rate. Keep cardinality controlled by bucketing.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: embeds-preflight-check v0.3 -> staging (sha: c0ffee).
ryan: will open runtime PR with detection + structured reject body: `{"error":"oversize_request", "estimated_units":420, "suggested_chunk":100, "help_url":"https://docs.redwood/embeds/chunking"}` and header `X-Embed-Suggest-Chunks:100`.
infra: good. add canary flags `embeds.preflight_mode=metrics|soft_reject|enforce`. tag @eng-oncall for SLO watch when we flip soft_reject.
console-pm: +1. want an easy Console toggle to opt a tenant into SDK autop-chunk experiment.
sdk-lead: we'll instrument conversion metrics and make it opt-out later.
ryan: ok moving forward. tickets: ING-2200 (preflight), SDK-601 (autochunk), DOC-349 (console preflight UX).
